caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with a lid, shown in both a detailed view and a scaled technical diagram below it. The teapot is white with gold accents along the rim, handle, spout, lid, and edges, and features a blue patterned design on the body. The lid has a rounded top with gold detailing and a knob. The handle is ornate with scrollwork, and the spout is elongated and curves upward. The main detailed view is at a scale of 1/2, as labeled at the top left. The technical diagram underneath shows front and side views with precise measurements: the total height with the lid is 7 1/8 inches, and the body width at the widest point is 4 1/2 inches; the lid is shown separately with a width of 2 1/4 inches and a height of 2 1/4 inches, scaled at 1/4. The gold decorations include leaf motifs on the handle and both sides of the spout. The artist's signature "Jos. Fuchs Jr." is located at the bottom right corner. The background is plain and uncolored, and all outlines are rendered in black ink.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
